section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single cross-sectional survey of 256 undergraduate female students enrolled at a large public university in the United Arab Emirates; participants were recruited from undergraduate psychology and general education courses. Participants were all of Arab descent and identified as Muslim; mean age was 20.35 years (SD = 1.81) and mean self-reported BMI was 22.98 (SD = 5.01). No information on the survey administration method (paper-and-pencil vs. online), any BAS/BAS-2 assessment, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI is provided.
